args.description: Corvid Retail credit request ($2,500) does not qualify under contract. March 2026 uptime: 99.94% (exceeds 99.5% SLA threshold). Contract DOC-0001 states: "SLA: if monthly uptime for Customer's region is below 99.5%, Customer receives a service credit of 10% of that month's subscription fee. No other credits apply." Customer email DOC-0202 (2026-03-30) claims $2,500 credit but is not contractually entitled.

args.text:
TO: Controller
FROM: Senior Accountant
DATE: 2026-04-03
RE: March 2026 Billing Adjustments - US Entity

I have completed the March billing adjustments for Halvard Systems Inc. (US) as follows:

SUMMARY OF ADJUSTMENTS:

1. ACME LOGISTICS - API USAGE OVERAGE (JE-00304, $1,136.00)
   • Contract basis: Order Form 3 provides 1,000,000 API calls/month included, overage at $0.004/call
   • March 2026 usage: 1,284,000 API calls (per DOC-0210, metering service final report)
   • Overage calculation: 284,000 calls × $0.004 = $1,136.00
   • Accounting: DR Accounts Receivable 1100 / CR Usage Revenue 4100
   • SLA assessment: 99.97% uptime exceeds 99.5% threshold - no SLA credit due
   • Support: DOC-0210 (usage report), DOC-0003 (contract)

2. BEACON HEALTH - SLA CREDIT (JE-00305, $800.00)
   • Contract basis: Subscription Agreement requires 99.5% monthly uptime; 10% credit if missed
   • March 2026 uptime: 99.31% (per DOC-0211, SRE-signed uptime report)
   • SLA failure confirmed: Incident INC-2291 on 2026-03-11, 5h02m downtime
   • Credit calculation: $8,000 monthly subscription × 10% = $800.00
   • Accounting: DR Subscription Revenue 4000 / CR Accounts Receivable 1100 (revenue reduction)
   • Support: DOC-0211 (uptime report), DOC-0002 (contract)

3. CORVID RETAIL - CREDIT REQUEST DENIED (EXC-001, flagged for review)
   • Customer request: $2,500 credit (DOC-0202, email dated 2026-03-30)
   • March 2026 uptime: 99.94% (per DOC-0211)
   • Contract provision: SLA credit applies only if uptime below 99.5%; contract states "No other credits apply"
   • Status: Request does NOT qualify per contract terms. Flagged as exception for controller review and customer communication.
   • Support: DOC-0202 (customer email), DOC-0001 (contract), DOC-0211 (uptime report)

OTHER CUSTOMERS REVIEWED:
• Corvid Retail: 99.94% uptime (meets 99.5% SLA) - no credit due
• Evergreen Bank: 99.97% uptime (meets 99.5% SLA) - no credit due
• Fairview Labs: 99.99% uptime (meets 99.5% SLA) - no credit due

REVENUE RECOGNITION CHECKLIST ITEM: Marked complete

Net March adjustments posted:
- Accounts Receivable: +$336 (overage billing of $1,136 less SLA credit of $800)
- Subscription Revenue: -$800 (SLA credit)
- Usage Revenue: +$1,136 (overage billing)

All entries have been posted with supporting documentation attached. Corvid Retail exception has been logged for controller review regarding customer relations protocol for disqualified credit requests.
